faq.a: Foster Martin at 1500 Martin Street, 1501 Foster Street and 1475 Foster Street was built 2021 onward, in stages by Landmark Premiere Properties, per the MLS® strata building record.
Foster Martin is 25, 25 and 24 (three towers) storeys with 345 apartments.

faq.q: What amenities does Foster Martin have?
faq.a: Indoor and outdoor pool, hot tub, sauna and steam room, a fitness room with yoga space, a party room, games room, a multi-purpose room with a kitchen, concierge, secured underground parking with electric car charging, and a resident shuttle.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Building facts from the City of White Rock info sheets and the MLS® strata building records, read November 14, 2026. Live search: Gerry’s 1452097.

Foster Martin is three towers of 24 and 25 storeys between Foster Street and Martin Street, with 345 apartments built by Landmark Premiere Properties and shops along the street. The towers are The Martin (1500 Martin Street), The Foster (1501 Foster Street) and The Landmark (1475 Foster Street).

blocks.text: Indoor and outdoor pool, hot tub, sauna and steam room, a fitness room with yoga space, a party room, games room, a multi-purpose room with a kitchen, concierge, secured underground parking with electric car charging, and a resident shuttle.

The towers are in the middle of White Rock’s Town Centre, a block off Johnston Road. Each tower has its own strata, so compare the fees, rules and reserve fund of the tower you are buying in, not the project as a whole.
